point: Manipulating physical blocks in childhood helps people learn to think and problem-solve through spatial reasoning.
quote: you were actually learning how to think and solve problems by understanding and manipulating spatial relationships

point: The researchers set out to create computers that allow users to physically grasp and arrange digital information with both hands.
quote: what if we could reach in with both hands and grasp information physically arranging it the way we wanted

point: Siftables are compact, cookie-sized interactive computers equipped with motion sensors, wireless radios, and screens.
quote: they can sense each other they can sense their motion and they have a screen and a wireless radio

point: Physical interfaces enable people to apply familiar real-world gestures directly to digital data manipulation.
quote: we could use everyday gestures on data like pouring a color the way we might pour a liquid

point: Siftables offer powerful educational possibilities in logic, math, and language by enabling rapid experimentation and instant feedback.
quote: there are also some neat possibilities for education like language math and logic games where we want to give people the ability to try things quickly

point: Physical computing tools are naturally intuitive to use, requiring very little instruction for people to get started.
quote: one of the interesting things about this kind of application is that you don't have to give people many instructions

point: Interactive storytelling tools allow language learners to direct open-ended narratives by physically moving and shaking characters.
quote: by shaking the siftables and putting them next to each other he can make the characters interact inventing his own narrative

point: Siftables can represent distinct musical elements that users assemble and manipulate into sequences.
quote: in which siftables act as sounds like lead bass and drums each of these has four different variations

point: The tangible music interface allows performers to actively improvise and restructure compositions live while they play.
quote: i can rearrange the sequence while it plays i don't have to plan it out in advance but i can improvise

point: The ultimate goal is building next-generation digital interfaces that naturally align with how human bodies and brains operate.
quote: my passion is for making new human computer interfaces that are a better match to the way our brains and bodies work
